caption:
Figure 1. Comparison of prompt-based methods. (a) Use task
ID to isolate prompt, which forces task-general prompt to be re-
learned at each task. (b) Missing annotations cause prompt tokens
to drift. (c) The shared prompt pool continuously optimizes task-
general prompt, and category prototypes guide the generation of
pseudo labels for old categories.
